import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    hist = inputs["dim_emp_hist"].copy()
    queries = inputs["asof_queries"].copy()

    # Normalize dtypes: ensure date-like columns are proper datetime for comparison.
    hist["emp_id"] = hist["emp_id"]
    hist["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(hist["eff_start_date"])
    # eff_end_date may contain NaT/None meaning "open" (current row)
    hist["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(hist["eff_end_date"])

    queries["emp_id"] = queries["emp_id"]
    queries["as_of_date"] = pd.to_datetime(queries["as_of_date"])

    # Inner join on emp_id, then filter by half-open interval condition.
    merged = queries.merge(
        hist,
        on="emp_id",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("", "_h"),
    )

    start_ok = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    end_ok = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])

    matched = merged[start_ok & end_ok]

    result = matched[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].copy()

    result = result.sort_values(by=["query_id", "emp_id"], kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"asof_result": result}
